§bAE2 Quest Counting§r

Carry a linked AE2 Wireless Terminal and items stored in its network count toward quest item tasks - in these chapters and the main GTNH questbook. Your inventory and the network are added together. Nothing is ever taken from the network; hand-in (consume) tasks are left alone.

§eCheck now§r: the "Check ME network" button in the quest book.
§eSettings§r: config/gtnhaddonquests/features.cfg (automaticCheck, includeMainQuestbook, requirePoweredNetwork, checkEverySeconds).

§aTask§r: have one in your inventory. It is not consumed.
